chemical-dosing-tank-bunded-50l.shortDescription: 50L round polyethylene chemical dosing tank for water treatment, chlorine, antiscalant and general chemical dosing. Compatible 50L secondary-containment bund available separately.
chemical-dosing-tank-bunded-50l.description:
A **50L round polyethylene chemical dosing tank** for water-treatment and chemical-dosing installations. The tank is supplied on its own, so customers who do not require secondary containment are not forced to buy a bund.

Manufactured from rotationally moulded linear low-density polyethylene (PE), the tank is formed without welded seams and is designed for chemical storage, mixing and dosing applications. The supplier lists resistance to acids, alkalis, impact and corrosion.

A **matching 50L chemical bund is available separately** and has been physically confirmed by the client to accept this tank. Bunding requirements vary by chemical, stored volume and jurisdiction, so site-specific requirements should be checked before installation.

- Tank only as standard
- Matching 50L bund sold separately
- Suitable for water treatment, chlorine, antiscalant and compatible chemical dosing
- Round format with removable top lid
- Optional dosing-pump, mixer and level accessories can be configured separately

chemical-bund-50l.shortDescription: 50L chemical secondary-containment bund matched to the 50L dosing tank. Approximate external geometric capacity 59L from supplier dimensions.
chemical-bund-50l.description:
A **50L chemical bund** for secondary containment around the matching 50L dosing tank. The client has physically confirmed that the 50L tank sits correctly inside this bund.

Supplier dimensions indicate a tapered round bund with a 480 mm top outside diameter, 360 mm bottom outside diameter and 425 mm height. Using those outside dimensions as a truncated-cone approximation gives about 59L of external geometric volume; actual usable containment is lower because of wall thickness and moulded geometry.

Bunding requirements vary by chemical, quantity and jurisdiction. Confirm the containment requirement for the intended installation.

compliance.note: Secondary-containment accessory. Confirm site-specific bunding requirements for the chemical, quantity and jurisdiction.

chemical-bund-400l.shortDescription: 400L standard chemical bund used as the optional secondary-containment bund for the 300L dosing tank. 945 mm top OD × 790 mm bottom OD × 743 mm high.
chemical-bund-400l.description:
A **400L standard chemical bund** for secondary containment. The client does not stock a 300L bund, so this 400L model is the optional bund offered with the 300L dosing tank.

The client-measured unit at roughly 95 cm wide × 75 cm high matches the supplier's standard M-400L specification: 945 mm top outside diameter, 790 mm bottom outside diameter and 743 mm height. A truncated-cone estimate from those outside dimensions gives approximately 440L external geometric volume.

The 300L dosing tank has been designated by the client to pair with this larger 400L bund where secondary containment is required.
